info.title: Game Event Script CLI
info.description: Command-line entry point for Game Event Script.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate source files without writing a binary. Use 'dotnet ges check --help' for options.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include bindings, dependencies, bytecode size, and resource requirements.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress success output. Errors are still reported.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
Sources are compiled and validated together without writing a binary or executing
handlers. Source order, UTF-8 decoding, and file-name patterns match 'dotnet ges compile'.
Checking does not resolve host extensions or external types against a runtime registry.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile UTF-8 source files together to .gesb. Use 'dotnet ges compile --help' for options.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file. Required for multiple sources; otherwise defaults to source.gesb.

options.name: --no-debug
options.description: Omit debug symbols, source map, and source archive.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include bindings, dependencies, bytecode size, and resource requirements.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress successful compilation output. Errors are still reported.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
Sources are compiled together in argument order. File-name patterns such as
"scripts/*.ges" expand in ordinal order; directory wildcards and recursion are not supported.
Repeated paths are included once, keeping their first position.
Output directories are created as needed. Existing output is replaced after
successful compilation. Source files must be UTF-8, with an optional UTF-8 BOM.

commands.name: dump
commands.description: Dump a .gesb file as GESA text. Use 'dotnet ges dump --help' for options.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --addresses
options.description: Include zero-based instruction addresses.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
The binary is validated before producing GESA text. Embedded debug information
is used when available; source files and host bindings are not required.
Output directories are created as needed. An existing output file is replaced
only after successful decoding and dump generation.
Terminal output uses four-column tab stops; files and redirected output retain tabs.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run Main(args), an event scenario, or the event console. Use 'dotnet ges run --help' for options.

options.name: --scenario
options.description: Run a separate scenario instead of Main. Repeat for combined sources.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Open the event console instead of Main. Initial files are optional.

options.name: --arg
options.description: Append exactly one value, even if it looks like an option.

options.name: --args
options.description: Append values until the next option. Negative numbers are values.

options.name: --color
options.description: Enable ANSI colors and live input highlighting (unless NO_COLOR is set).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Trace emit, publish, and dispatch on stderr; yellow in colored interactive mode.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Hide completion/load/unload/reload reports; console output and errors remain visible.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Signed 64-bit random seed. Omit for a fresh host seed.

options.name: --max-messages
options.description: Maximum processed messages per pump/input (default: 64).

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Maximum execution steps per handler (default: 100000).
